title: Love
text: Love. I love it. It's cute and perfect!

product_metadata.title: 8x10 Vintage Style Sign with Pine Trees Saying"Welcome to Papa's Place The Man, The Myth, The Legend." Decorative Fun Universal Household Family Signs for your Grandpa (8x10)
features: A very welcoming sign featuring a popular nickname for Grandpa! Papa will love it!
It features a faux vintage style design with pine trees and the moon. The sign was made to look older than it actually is.
Easy to Hang: Simple black cord can hang anywhere in the house! Just need a nail or hook!
Father's Day Friendly! Also great for Birthdays, Christmas, National Grandparent's Day, and other Special Occasions!
Size: 8x10 Inches - A perfect addition to Grandpa's home decor!
description: Signs are made of tempered hardboard and have a vintage faux finished background which creates the illusion of an aged vintage sign. It is well made and displays beautifully.
